_note: Week of June 1–7, 2026. Mediterranean diet pivot. Taco Tuesday stays (shrimp + chicken, corn tortillas). Fish-forward (cod Mon+Fri, salmon Thu). Jake lunch: chicken + chickpea bowl with lemon herb sauce. Laine lunch: cold pasta salad with tuna + bell pepper, mason jar style. Olive oil replaces most other fats. Garlic, lemon, herbs everywhere.

dinners.name: Lemon Herb Cod + Quinoa + Cherry Tomatoes
dinners.note: Classic Mediterranean opener. Cod baked with olive oil and lemon, quinoa for fiber, fresh cherry tomatoes stirred in at the end.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat cod dry, place in baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with garlic powder, oregano, paprika, salt.
Bake 14–16 min until fish flakes easily.
Cook quinoa: rinse, simmer in 2× water 15 min, fluff. Jake 60g dry, Laine 50g dry.
Halve cherry tomatoes. Toss into warm quinoa with spinach — let the heat wilt the spinach slightly.
Plate: quinoa base, cod on top. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon.

dinners.name: Chicken + Shrimp Tacos
dinners.note: Taco Tuesday stays. Fresh chicken and shrimp, corn tortillas. Jake more chicken, Laine more shrimp. Feta crumble instead of cheddar for the med lean.

ingredients.item: Cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt

steps: Slice chicken thin. Season with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt.
Cook chicken in olive oil over medium-high 3–4 min per side until cooked through. Rest 2 min, slice.
In same pan, cook shrimp 2 min per side with remaining seasoning.
Warm tortillas on dry pan or open flame 30 sec each side.
Build tacos: Jake more chicken, Laine more shrimp. Top with cherry tomatoes + sour cream.

dinners.name: Lemon Herb Chicken + Garbanzo Bean Skillet
dinners.note: Full Mediterranean Wednesday. Chicken thighs + chickpeas + lemon + garlic + spinach. No grain — fiber from chickpeas. Olive oil does the work.
steps: Slice chicken. Season with garlic powder, oregano, cumin, salt.
Heat olive oil in skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 3–4 min per side. Remove and rest.
Add chickpeas to pan, toss and warm 2 min. Add cherry tomatoes and cook 2 more min.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Return chicken to pan.
Deglaze with lemon juice. Jake gets bigger portion. Serve immediately.

dinners.name: Baked Salmon + Rice + Spinach
dinners.note: Salmon Thursday. Omega-3 night — fat numbers look high but it's all salmon. Jake bigger fillet. White rice for easy carbs, spinach wilted in lemon oil.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush salmon with olive oil, season with garlic powder, paprika, oregano, salt.
Bake 14–16 min. Rest 2 min.
Cook rice per package directions. Jake 70g dry, Laine 75g dry.
Wilt spinach in remaining olive oil + lemon in a small pan over medium, 2 min.
Plate: rice base, salmon on top, wilted spinach alongside.

dinners.name: Cod + Cannellini Bean Skillet
dinners.note: Lean clean Friday. Cod on white beans is very Med. Quick pan sauce with lemon + olive oil. No grain — beans handle the carbs.
steps: Thaw cod, pat dry. Season with garlic powder, oregano, salt.
Heat olive oil over medium-high. Cook cod 3–4 min per side. Remove.
Add beans and cherry tomatoes to pan. Warm 2 min, crushing a few beans with back of spoon.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Add lemon juice and stir.
Plate beans mixture, cod on top. Extra lemon squeeze to finish.

dinners.name: Shrimp + Lemon Garlic Pasta
dinners.note: Weekend pasta night, Mediterranean style. Olive oil, lemon, garlic — no heavy cream sauce. Spinach stirred in. Jake bigger bowl.

ingredients.item: Garlic powder, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt

steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve ¼ cup pasta water. Drain.
Cook shrimp in olive oil over medium-high with garlic powder, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt — 2 min per side.
Add cherry tomatoes to pan, cook 2 min until slightly blistered.
Add spinach, stir until wilted. Add pasta + splash of pasta water. Squeeze in lemon.
Toss to coat. Jake bigger bowl. Serve immediately.

dinners.name: Birch Benders Pancake Night + Egg White Scramble
dinners.note: Standing Sunday breakfast-for-dinner. Flaxseed in the batter. Thawed frozen fruit on top. Jake bigger stack.
steps: Thaw frozen fruit at room temp or microwave 60 sec.
Mix pancake mix + egg whites + water per pkg. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook on greased griddle over medium, 2–3 min per side.
Jake gets bigger stack. Top both with thawed fruit.

jakeLunch.name: Chicken + Chickpea Bowl with Lemon Herb Sauce
jakeLunch.note: W23 Mediterranean pivot. Same batch-cook format — 5 containers Sunday. Chickpeas replace black beans for the med lean. Lemon herb sauce instead of roasted onion garlic. Edamame still in for protein.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — 2.5 lbs total, 227g raw per container
Garbanzo beans — 2 cans total, 0.4 can per container
Signature Select pasta sauce (garlic basil) — 2.5 cups total, 1/2 cup per container
Frozen edamame (shelled) — 2.5 cups total, 1/2 cup per container
Frozen veggies — 5 cups total, 1 cup per container

steps: Bake ALL chicken (2.5 lbs) at 400°F for 24 min. Cool and dice or shred.
Cook chickpeas: heat in pan with olive oil, garlic powder, cumin, salt until slightly crispy — 5 min.
Add pasta sauce, edamame, lemon juice. Stir together and simmer 5 min.
Steam/microwave all frozen veggies separately. Set aside.
Divide into 5 containers: chicken + chickpea mixture base, then 1 cup veggies on top.
Drizzle with remaining lemon + olive oil. Seal and refrigerate. Reheat 2 min with a splash of water.

laineLunch.name: Tuna & Chicken Pasta Salad — Mason Jar Style (Bell Pepper Edition)
laineLunch.note: Same mason jar format. Bell pepper for crunch and color. Dressing separate. 2 sittings per jar. Laine approved.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Light Italian or Caesar — 2 tbsp per jar in a separate container.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — 2 breasts (~800g raw), 147g raw per jar
Garofalo pasta (rotini or penne) — 250g dry total, 50g per jar
Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Bell pepper — 1 large diced, ~100g per jar
Fresh baby spinach — big handful per jar (~30g)
Light Italian or Caesar dressing — 2 tbsp per jar (kept separate)
Lemon juice, garlic powder, salt (for chicken)

steps: Season chicken with garlic powder, salt, pepper, squeeze of lemon. Bake at 400°F for 24 min. Cool completely, dice small.
Cook all pasta in salted water. Drain, rinse cold, toss with tiny bit of olive oil.
Dice bell pepper. Slice cucumber. Rinse spinach.
Drain tuna cans well.
Layer each mason jar: pasta → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper → chicken → spinach on top.
Put 2 tbsp dressing in a separate small container per jar. Refrigerate.
When eating: pour dressing in, shake, eat half — reseal for second sitting.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into bowl or jar. Top with thawed fruit and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble
steps: Scramble egg whites over medium-low with frozen veggies until just set. Top with cheese.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Pancakes + Fruit

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake mix — 1/2 cup dry

steps: Mix pancake mix + egg whites + water. Cook small pancakes 2 min per side. Top with fruit + flaxseed.

jakeSnacks.name: Egg White Mug + Cheese
jakeSnacks.desc: 1/2 cup liquid egg whites microwaved 90 sec. Top with 1 tbsp shredded cheese.

jakeSnacks.name: Tuna Straight from Can
jakeSnacks.desc: Drain and eat with a fork. Add hot sauce or lemon.

jakeSnacks.name: Frozen Edamame + Flaxseed
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup edamame thawed/microwaved + 1 tbsp flaxseed. Great fiber + protein combo.

Garbanzo beans — 3 cans (Jake lunch batch × 2 + Wed dinner × 1)
